acceptedInterpretation: Unify host-side LLM usage capture into the single existing ledger (.lattice/usage/llm-usage.jsonl) via one launcher choke point, expressed as the current 5-row milestone ledger. M1-CAPTURE (CHK-001/CHK-002) adds a host_run command launching codex/claude/agy through the B-d8ef canonical launcher argv and writing correlated preflight+final usage rows bound to storyId/agentType/phase/provider plus threadId=reviewRunId and subagentId=lane; codex usage is parsed from the exec --json turn.completed event, claude from stream-json result usage, and agy records an explicit usage.source=unavailable final because it exposes no per-call usage surface. M1-COVERAGE (CHK-003) extends the same seam to the remaining lattice-initiated spawns (autopilot repair, host readiness probes, cross_host_review codex leaf) with ledger OFF byte-identical. M1-GUIDANCE (CHK-004) routes operator-facing reviewer/quorum launch guidance through host_run and adds docs/host-run-usage.md, verified by an rg absence check on raw-launch instruction strings. M1-CAPS (CHK-007, the same-day T2 follow-up) adds a fail-closed per-dispatch hard-budget cap and a host-run concurrency cap that refuse over-limit runs before spawn and write diagnostics-honest blocked rows (hard_budget_exceeded / concurrency_cap_exceeded) with stale-slot reclaim. M2-SWEEP (CHK-005/CHK-006) adds a strictly read-only usage_sweep scanning ~/.codex/sessions rollouts and ~/.claude/projects transcripts since a cutoff and emitting a clearly NON-AUTHORITATIVE per-session attribution report (token totals, story mentions, cwd, originator), together with the QA wiring folded into this row: both fixture smokes (host-run-usage and usage-sweep) runnable as npm scripts plus docs/CHANGELOG updates. Non-goals hold throughout: usage rows stay gateEvidence=false diagnostics, the sweep never backfills the ledger or feeds gates, and interactive desktop sessions are report-only and never intercepted.
